JetBlue Airways is set to debut its latest transcontinental service as the airline begins flying from San Diego International Airport (SAN) to Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) on November 19. The airline's expansion of its transcontinental footprint will see the launch of a daily service between Southern California and South Florida.

The flight will operate with a block time of almost six hours. The daily service will be operated onboard the airline's Airbus A321ceo and marks the return of the airline, which previously served the route periodically between June 2016 and January 2025.

Nonstop JetBlue Flights From San Diego To Fort Lauderdale

The corridor between San Diego and Fort Lauderdale is tight, with three competitors all operating multiple weekly flights across the year. Alaska Airlines provides nonstop flights on the route, while Southwest Airlines adds a seasonal service between November and January.
JetBlue's resumption on the route marks the third to begin out of Fort Lauderdale, adding to the new flights to Indianapolis International Airport (IND) and Columbus (CMH).

As already mentioned, JetBlue will fly the route daily with the schedule below, departing in the early morning from Fort Lauderdale, with aircraft pushing back at 7:00 AM, for a mid-morning arrival into San Diego . Return flights depart late morning for an early evening arrival into Florida.
Building On Growth From Fort Lauderdale Following Spirit Airlines Collapse

JetBlue has expanded aggressively at Fort Lauderdale since Spirit Airlines' collapse in May . The airline is now the largest airline at the South Florida airport, and the airport has even been suggested to be a highly likely location for the airline's third BlueHouse lounge .

From Fort Lauderdale, JetBlue has a network of 62 total destinations, with the most popular routes from the airport being to New York (JFK), Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), New York (LGA), Boston Logan International Airport (BOS), and San Juan (SJU).

As already mentioned, JetBlue has operated the route from San Diego to Fort Lauderdale before, having operated it up until January 2025. During the eight and a half years the airline operated the service, it had an average load factor of 82.5%, according to data from the US Department of Transportation . In the final months before the route was axed, 85% of passengers traveled on the route point to point, whereas a further 15% connected onto another JetBlue flight.
JetBlue's Top Destinations From Fort Lauderdale

This coming winter season, JetBlue's major routes from Fort Lauderdale are to New York JFK and Los Angeles LAX, which, from November through the summer of 2027, will see in excess of 1,900 flights up until May. 捷蓝航空恢复该航线是第三条从劳德代尔堡出发的航线，增加了飞往印第安纳波利斯国际机场 (IND) 和哥伦布 (CMH) 的新航班。

title_en: 14,388 Miles: Airbus A350-1000ULR Test Flight Officially Breaks The Guinness World Record
title_zh: 14,388 英里：空中客车 A350-1000ULR 试飞正式打破吉尼斯世界纪录
summary: Airbus has eclipsed Boeing's legendary Baby Blue 2 record, validating the A350-1000ULR ahead of Qantas' Project Sunrise launch.
summary_zh: 空客公司已经超越了波音公司传奇的 Baby Blue 2 记录，在澳洲航空“日出计划”启动之前验证了 A350-1000ULR。
body_en: Paul has had a career of 25+ years focused on the international technology sector, which has taken him to over 100 countries. Along the way, he developed a deep love for aviation, with a travel bucket list measured by aircraft types flown rather than destinations reached. Now he brings that avgeek passion, along with the journalism experience he accumulated early in his career, to write insightful pieces for Simple Flying.

Airbus has officially broken the Guinness World Record for the longest nonstop flight by a commercial airliner , with its Airbus A350-1000ULR covering an extraordinary 14,388 miles (23,155 km) in 24 hours and 24 minutes. The achievement, announced earlier today, ends a record held for more than two decades by Boeing with its Boeing 777-200LR Worldliner.

The flight took place between Melbourne Airport (MEL) and Toulouse-Blagnac Airport (TLS) on July 27–28 as part of the A350-1000ULR's development program for Qantas' Project Sunrise. Remarkably, the official announcement of the record came exactly 21 years after Boeing's record-setting aircraft departed Hong Kong on November 9, 2005. The achievement represents an important milestone ahead of Qantas' planned introduction of nonstop Sydney–London services in October 2027.
Inside The Airbus A350-1000ULR's Extraordinary 24-Hour Flight

Operating as AIB35LR , the Airbus A350-1000ULR departed Melbourne at 5:27 PM local time on July 27, arriving in Toulouse at 9:51 AM the following morning. The aircraft flew eastwards, initially flying over Sydney before crossing the Pacific toward Los Angeles, traversing North America and the Atlantic, and passing over London. The extraordinary routing crossed three continents and two oceans, treating those onboard to two sunsets and two sunrises.

The flight carried just 13 people, including three Airbus test pilots, two Qantas pilots, engineers and an International Aeronautical Federation representative. The extended flight-test program focused particularly on fuel management and cabin environmental systems. Airbus also evaluated its redesigned crew-rest compartments, while pilots operated overlapping four-hour shifts, staggered every two hours.

Today's Guinness certification follows independent validation of aircraft data by the International Aeronautical Federation and Flightradar24 . Interestingly, Airbus originally reported the flight distance as 14,338 miles (23,076 km), approximately 50 miles (79 km) shorter than the officially certified figure. Airbus Commercial Aircraft CEO Lars Wagner described the achievement as confirmation of the aircraft's ultra-long-range capabilities, adding

"This achievement reflects the pioneering and innovative spirit that is part of our DNA at Airbus. Flying 12,503 nautical miles non-stop, we have fully proven the aircraft's capability to fulfill its mission. And the world record was the icing on the cake!”
How Airbus Finally Broke Baby Blue 2's 21-Year-Old World Record

To achieve the record, Airbus had to surpass a truly extraordinary journey. On November 9, 2005, Boeing's distinctive blue-and-white 777-200LR demonstrator, N6066Z , nicknamed Baby Blue 2, departed Hong Kong International Airport (HKG) on a momentous journey.

Rather than following the conventional westbound route to London, Captain Suzanna Darcy-Hennemann and her crew headed east across the Pacific. The aircraft crossed North America and the Atlantic before reaching Heathrow, setting a remarkable record of 13,423 miles (21,601 km) in 22 hours and 42 minutes.

The Worldliner carried 35 people, including Boeing executives, engineers, airline representatives and journalists. Its fuel tanks contained approximately 164 tonnes of fuel, with the weight of passengers and baggage carefully controlled. A specially fitted interior even featured a reception area and business class seating. Remarkably, the aircraft still had approximately two hours of fuel remaining upon arrival. Baby Blue 2 subsequently entered commercial service with Pakistan International Airlines as AP-BGZ .

Two decades later, Airbus has finally surpassed Boeing's achievement. The A350-1000ULR benefits from advances in composite structures, aerodynamics and engine efficiency, alongside a new rear center fuel tank holding approximately 5,521 gallons (20,900 liters). The modification extends the A350-1000's range by approximately 1,000 nautical miles (1,151 miles, 1,852 km).
Qantas' Project Sunrise Will Launch In October 2027

The record comes as the Australian flag carrier edges closer to introducing the world's longest scheduled passenger flights. The airline expects its first A350-1000ULR delivery in April 2027, with nonstop Sydney–London services launching in October under flight numbers QF1 and QF2 . The existing Singapore-stop services will continue as QF5 and QF6. Sydney–New York will follow in mid-2028, with Qantas expecting the new nonstop journey to take approximately 18 hours.

Qantas has ordered 12 A350-1000ULRs, each configured with 238 seats, including 98 premium seats and a dedicated Wellbeing Zone. The commercial strategy centers on attracting higher-yield passengers while removing the inconvenience of stopovers. Qantas forecasts approximately A$400 million ($265 million) in additional annual earnings once Project Sunrise reaches scale, supported by new nonstop flying, network optimization and freight opportunities. Its broader fleet strategy also includes 12 standard A350-1000s.

Significant operational preparations remain underway. Qantas is preparing more than 360 pilots and 1,200 cabin crew for the new fleet, while simulator training has already begun in Sydney. Aircraft certification, crew preparation and further deliveries will determine how quickly the airline can expand its network. With five A350-1000ULRs expected by November 2027, the Guinness World Record marks a remarkable engineering accomplishment, but the more consequential achievement will be translating that capability into regular commercial operations.

body_zh: Paul 拥有超过 25 年的职业生涯，专注于国际技术领域，足迹遍布 100 多个国家。一路走来，他对航空产生了深深的热爱，他的旅行愿望清单是根据飞行的飞机类型而不是到达的目的地来衡量的。现在，他带着这种平均极客的热情，以及他在职业生涯早期积累的新闻经验，为《简单飞行》撰写了富有洞察力的文章。
空中客车公司正式打破了商用客机最长直飞飞行的吉尼斯世界纪录，其空中客车 A350-1000ULR 在 24 小时 24 分钟内飞行了 14,388 英里（23,155 公里）。今天早些时候宣布的这一成就结束了波音公司以其波音 777-200LR Worldliner 保持了二十多年的记录。
该航班于 7 月 27 日至 28 日在墨尔本机场 (MEL) 和图卢兹布拉尼亚克机场 (TLS) 之间进行，是澳洲航空 Sunrise 项目 A350-1000ULR 开发计划的一部分。值得注意的是，这一纪录的正式宣布是在波音公司创纪录的飞机于 2005 年 11 月 9 日从香港起飞整整 21 年后。这一成就是澳洲航空计划于 2027 年 10 月推出悉尼至伦敦直航服务之前的一个重要里程碑。
空客 A350-1000ULR 非凡的 24 小时飞行内部
这架空客 A350-1000ULR 的航班号为 AIB35LR，于当地时间 7 月 27 日下午 5:27 从墨尔本出发，于次日上午 9:51 抵达图卢兹。飞机向东飞行，最初飞越悉尼，然后穿越太平洋飞往洛杉矶，穿越北美和大西洋，最后经过伦敦。这条非凡的航线跨越了三大洲和两大洋，让船上的人看到了两次日落和两次日出。
该航班仅载有 13 人，其中包括三名空客试飞员、两名澳航飞行员、工程师和一名国际航空联合会代表。扩展的飞行测试计划特别关注燃油管理和机舱环境系统。空中客车公司还评估了其重新设计的机组人员休息舱，而飞行员则实行四小时重叠轮班，每两小时错开一次。
今天的吉尼斯认证是在国际航空联合会和 Flightradar24 对飞机数据进行独立验证之后获得的。有趣的是，空客最初报告的飞行距离为14,338英里（23,076公里），比官方认证的数字短约50英里（79公里）。空中客车商用飞机公司首席执行官拉尔斯·瓦格纳 (Lars Wagner) 将这一成就描述为对飞机超远程能力的确认，并补充道
“这一成就体现了空客的开拓创新精神。不间断飞行12,503海里，我们充分证明了飞机完成使命的能力。而世界纪录更是锦上添花！”
空客如何最终打破 Baby Blue 2 保持 21 年之久的世界纪录
为了实现这一纪录，空中客车公司必须超越一次真正非凡的旅程。 2005 年 11 月 9 日，波音公司独特的蓝白色 777-200LR 验证机 N6066Z（绰号“宝贝蓝 2”）离开香港国际机场 (HKG)，踏上重要的旅程。
船长苏珊娜·达西-亨尼曼 (Suzanna Darcy-Hennemann) 和她的船员没有沿着传统的西行路线前往伦敦，而是向东穿越太平洋。该飞机穿越北美和大西洋，然后抵达希思罗机场，在 22 小时 42 分钟内创下了 13,423 英里（21,601 公里）的非凡纪录。
Worldliner 载有 35 人，其中包括波音公司高管、工程师、航空公司代表和记者。其油箱装有约 164 吨燃油，乘客和行李的重量受到严格控制。特别装修的内饰甚至还设有接待区和商务舱座椅。值得注意的是，飞机抵达时还剩下大约两个小时的燃油。婴儿蓝 2 随后进入巴基斯坦国际航空公司的商业服务，编号为 AP-BGZ。
二十年后，空客终于超越了波音的成就。 A350-1000ULR 受益于复合材料结构、空气动力学和发动机效率方面的进步，以及新的后中央油箱，容量约为 5,521 加仑（20,900 升）。此次改装将 A350-1000 的航程延长了约 1,000 海里（1,151 英里，1,852 公里）。
澳洲航空 Sunrise 项目将于 2027 年 10 月启动
这一纪录的出现正值这家澳大利亚旗舰航空公司即将推出世界上最长的定期客运航班的时刻。该航空公司预计将于 2027 年 4 月交付首架 A350-1000ULR，并于 10 月推出航班号为 QF1 和 QF2 的悉尼至伦敦直飞航班。现有的新加坡经停航班将继续作为 QF5 和 QF6。悉尼-纽约航线将于 2028 年中期开通，澳洲航空预计新的直达旅程大约需要 18 小时。
澳洲航空已订购 12 架 A350-1000ULR，每架配置 238 个座位，其中包括 98 个高级座位和一个专门的健康区。商业策略的重点是吸引高收益乘客，同时消除中途停留的不便。澳洲航空预计，一旦“Sunrise”项目达到规模，在新的直飞航班、网络优化和货运机会的支持下，每年将额外获得约 4 亿澳元（2.65 亿美元）的额外收入。其更广泛的机队战略还包括 12 架标准 A350-1000。

An Airbus A350-1000ULR developed for Qantas has set a Guinness World Record for the longest flight by distance by a commercial airliner, Airbus announced on 9 November. The aircraft covered 12,503 nautical miles (23,155 km) non-stop from Melbourne to Toulouse on 27–28 July 2026. The Fédération Aéronautique Internationale and Flightradar24 independently validated the flight data, Airbus said.

The Airbus-operated test flight carried 13 people, including two Qantas pilots. It routed via Sydney, crossed the Pacific towards Los Angeles, then flew across North America and the Atlantic before passing over London en route to Toulouse.

Qantas has ordered 12 A350-1000ULRs for Project Sunrise, with the first delivery scheduled for April 2027 and non-stop Sydney–London services planned for later that year. The variant is also intended for Sydney–New York flights. An additional rear centre fuel tank extends its range by about 1,000 nautical miles.

body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

New routes are usually intriguing, and can be especially notable when more than one launch on the same day. That is what happened with JetBlue Airways last week, as the carrier introduced two links from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL) and one from Baltimore/Washington International Thurgood Marshall Airport (BWI).

JetBlue's growth at FLL has been significant recently, as the airline benefits from the end of the now-defunct Spirit Airlines. In the present week, Cirium Diio data indicates that FLL is currently the airline's most-served airport. 856 weekly departures are available, exceeding those from New York JFK (816) and Boston (811).
JetBlue Begins Flying From Baltimore To San Juan

On November 2, the carrier took off from BWI to San Juan's Luis Muñoz Marín International Airport (SJU). As Puerto Rico is a US territory, flights are considered domestic. As the service only covers 1,360 nautical miles (2,519 km) on a great circle basis, it is only JetBlue's ninth-longest route from the Lower 48 states to SJU through next summer.

Flown daily on a year-round basis, it is the first time that JetBlue has served the airport pair. The airline will be one of three carriers running nonstop, joining Frontier Airlines (up to one daily service) and Southwest Airlines (up to three daily flights). JetBlue's entry follows the exit of Spirit earlier this year.

Given the schedule, the operating Airbus A320 will fly from somewhere to SJU to BWI to SJU and then elsewhere. For example, on November 8, Flightradar24 indicates that the airframe, the 20.5-year-old N638JB, flew from Hartford to Puerto Rico. It then flew to Maryland and back, remained overnight in SJU, and flew to FLL the next morning.
JetBlue Has Launched Flights From Fort Lauderdale To Columbus

Also on Monday, November 2, the airline began flying from FLL to John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH). Flights run daily throughout the year. While the 162-seat A320 is nearly always scheduled, the 140-seat A220-300 is due to appear from September 8, 2027. As that is so far away, it is quite possible that it'll change. The operating airframe remains overnight in Ohio.

JetBlue was interested in this market because Spirit pulled out early this year and had up to two daily services. It joins Frontier, which entered the market in March this year (up to a daily departure), and Southwest (usually daily, but up to four daily services for spring break). JetBlue's entry means that the airport pair has up to six daily flights, just like it did when Spirit operated, although that frequency is very time-limited.

In the 12 months to July 2026, the US Department of Transportation shows that 235,200 round-trip passengers flew between FLL and CMH. Excluding seasonality, around 640 people traveled daily. About three-quarters of the traffic flew nonstop, meaning approximately 57,000 passengers (156 daily) flew via a hub or other airport en route. Spirit had 38% of the total traffic (89,500).
Finally, There Is Fort Lauderdale To Indianapolis

Launched on (you guessed it) November 2, FLL to Indianapolis International Airport (IND) follows the same pattern as the other two routes. But it is even more significant because it is the first time that the carrier has flown to IND and Indiana.

Spirit operated FLL-IND earlier this year, which motivated JetBlue's entry. Like the other routes mentioned earlier, it is also primarily served daily on the A320. However, the A220 (shown above) is scheduled from December 17, 2026, until January 3, 2027, then from February 11 to 22, and again from September 8 next year.

JetBlue is one of four operators running nonstop between FLL and IND, coexisting with Allegiant Air (up to 12 weekly), Frontier (up to one daily), and Southwest (up to three daily departures). When added to CMH and the upcoming transcontinental route from FLL to San Diego, JetBlue has 62 routes from FLL this winter.

新航线通常很有趣，当同一天推出多条航线时尤其引人注目。这就是捷蓝航空上周发生的情况，该航空公司推出了两条从劳德代尔堡好莱坞国际机场 (FLL) 出发的航班和一条从巴尔的摩/华盛顿瑟古德马歇尔国际机场 (BWI) 出发的航班。

最后，从劳德代尔堡到印第安纳波利斯

今年早些时候，Spirit 运营了 FLL-IND，这推动了捷蓝航空的进入。与前面提到的其他航线一样，该航线也主要由 A320 每天提供服务。然而，A220（如上图所示）的飞行时间为2026年12月17日至2027年1月3日，然后是2月11日至22日，以及明年9月8日。
捷蓝航空是往返于 FLL 和 IND 之间直达航班的四家运营商之一，与忠诚航空（每周最多 12 班）、边疆航空（每天最多 1 班）和西南航空（每天最多 3 班）共存。加上 CMH 和即将开通的从 FLL 飞往圣地亚哥的跨大陆航线，捷蓝航空今年冬季将开通 62 条从 FLL 出发的航线。

随着情况稳定下来，该航空公司得以恢复其飞往以色列的长途航线。该航线将由该航空公司的波音 787-9 每周执飞 3 班。
旧金山航线将于 3 月份恢复运营，成为美联航第四条直飞特拉维夫的航线，补充该航空公司现有的芝加哥 (ORD)、纽瓦克 (EWR) 和华盛顿杜勒斯 (IAD) 航班服务。

title_en: Royal Navy launches strike drones from HMS Queen Elizabeth for first time
title_zh: 英国皇家海军首次从伊丽莎白女王号上发射攻击无人机
summary: The Royal Navy has launched one-way strike drones from an aircraft carrier for the first time, sending four… The post Royal Navy launches strike drones from HMS Queen Elizabeth for first time appeared first on AeroTime .
summary_zh: 英国皇家海军首次从航空母舰上发射了单向攻击无人机，派出了四架……皇家海军发射攻击无人机后
body_en: The Royal Navy has launched one-way strike drones from an aircraft carrier for the first time, sending four Nyan Maritime drones from the flight deck of HMS Queen Elizabeth during trials in the North Atlantic in mid-October 2026.
According to BAE Systems, whose subsidiary Callen-Lenz designs and builds the drone, all four Nyans reached their designated strike points during Exercise Neptune Reach B.

Nyan is a small uncrewed aircraft with a 2.9-meter (approximately 9.5-foot) wingspan, designed for precision strikes, according to BAE Systems. The Royal Navy refers to the trial version as Nyan Maritime.
The carrier launches follow Nyan’s first launch at sea from the experimental vessel XV Patrick Blackett off the south coast of England in July 2026.

Known as Neptune Reach A, the earlier demonstration involved personnel from 26 Regiment Royal Artillery and 744 Naval Air Squadron. The drone was launched from a deck-mounted launcher while the vessel was underway.

Both Neptune Reach A and Neptune Reach B form part of Project Vantage, a joint Royal Navy, British Army and Royal Air Force initiative aimed at accelerating the testing and deployment of maritime strike drones.
Tekever AR5 completes carrier takeoffs and landings
HMS Queen Elizabeth also hosted Heavy Lift Challenge 3, during which a Tekever AR5 fixed-wing drone operated from a Royal Navy aircraft carrier for the first time.
The AR5 has a seven-meter (approximately 23-foot) wingspan and can carry a payload of up to 80 kilograms (approximately 176 pounds), according to the Royal Navy.
Tekever said the AR5 departed from its flight operations center in Atouguia da Baleia, Portugal, and flew for approximately 90 minutes to reach HMS Queen Elizabeth.

After reaching the carrier, the AR5 completed two landings and two takeoffs from its flight deck before making the two-hour return flight to Portugal. The exercise explored the potential use of carrier-based drones for logistics, sustainment and intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) missions.

The AR5 has already secured another role in the British armed forces. In July 2026, the UK Ministry of Defence selected the type to replace the British Army’s Watchkeeper drones under Project Corvus, with a contract worth up to £400 million (approximately $535 million) subsequently awarded to Tekever in September 2026.
Royal Navy advances hybrid carrier air wing plans
The Royal Navy sees the Nyan and AR5 demonstrations as steps toward a hybrid carrier air wing, combining uncrewed aircraft with crewed platforms such as the F-35B fighter.
Its ambitions also extend to autonomous rotorcraft, including the Leonardo Proteus demonstrator , which completed its maiden flight in January 2026.
The service has linked these developments to the Defence Investment Plan published on June 30, 2026 , which commits more than £5 billion (approximately $6.7 billion) to autonomous systems by 2030.
That includes almost £250 million (approximately $334 million) for Project Pantheon, an initiative to develop the hybrid carrier air wing and test jet-powered drones alongside F-35B fighters.
At least £210 million (approximately $281 million) is also earmarked for low-cost, long-range one-way attack drones that could be deployed across the Royal Navy, British Army and Royal Air Force.

body_zh: 英国皇家海军首次从航空母舰上发射单向攻击无人机，2026 年 10 月中旬在北大西洋进行的试验期间，从伊丽莎白女王号的飞行甲板上发射了四架 Nyan Maritime 无人机。
BAE Systems 旗下的 Callen-Lenz 设计和制造了这架无人机，据 BAE Systems 称，在 Neptune Reach B 演习中，所有四架 Nyan 均已到达指定攻击点。
据 BAE Systems 称，Nyan 是一种小型无人驾驶飞机，翼展 2.9 米（约 9.5 英尺），专为精确打击而设计。英国皇家海军将试用版称为“Nyan Maritime”。
继 Nyan 于 2026 年 7 月在英格兰南海岸附近的 XV Patrick Blackett 实验船首次海上发射之后，又进行了航母发射。
早期的演示被称为“Neptune Reach A”，来自第 26 皇家炮兵团和第 744 海军航空中队的人员参加。无人机是在船舶航行时从甲板上安装的发射器发射的。
Neptune Reach A 和 Neptune Reach B 都是 Vantage 项目的一部分，该项目是英国皇家海军、英国陆军和皇家空军联合发起的项目，旨在加速海上攻击无人机的测试和部署。
Tekever AR5完成航母起降
伊丽莎白女王号还举办了第三次重型起重挑战赛，其中 Tekever AR5 固定翼无人机首次在皇家海军航空母舰上进行操作。
据英国皇家海军称，AR5 的翼展长达 7 米（约 23 英尺），可承载高达 80 公斤（约 176 磅）的有效载荷。
Tekever 表示，AR5 从葡萄牙 Atouguia da Baleia 的飞行运营中心起飞，飞行约 90 分钟到达伊丽莎白女王号。
到达航母后，AR5 在飞行甲板上完成了两次着陆和两次起飞，然后进行了两个小时的返回葡萄牙的飞行。此次演习探讨了舰载无人机在后勤、保障和情报、监视、目标获取和侦察（ISTAR）任务中的潜在用途。
AR5 已经在英国武装部队中占据了另一个角色。 2026 年 7 月，英国国防部在 Corvus 项目下选择了该型号来取代英国陆军的 Watchkeeper 无人机，并于 2026 年 9 月向 Tekever 授予了一份价值高达 4 亿英镑（约合 5.35 亿美元）的合同。
皇家海军推进混合舰载机联队计划
英国皇家海军将 Nyan 和 AR5 演示视为混合舰载机联队的一步，将无人驾驶飞机与 F-35B 战斗机等载人平台相结合。
它的野心还扩展到自动旋翼飞机，包括 Leonardo Proteus 演示机，该飞机于 2026 年 1 月完成了首次飞行。
该军种将这些进展与 2026 年 6 月 30 日发布的国防投资计划联系起来，该计划承诺到 2030 年为自主系统提供超过 50 亿英镑（约 67 亿美元）。
其中包括近 2.5 亿英镑（约合 3.34 亿美元）的万神殿计划，该计划旨在开发混合舰载机联队并与 F-35B 战斗机一起测试喷气动力无人机。
至少 2.1 亿英镑（约合 2.81 亿美元）还专门用于低成本、远程单向攻击无人机，可部署在皇家海军、英国陆军和皇家空军中。

title_en: Boeing Cuts 5% Of Commercial Airplanes Workforce As Production Ramp-Up Slows
title_zh: 由于产量增速放缓，波音公司削减了 5% 的商用飞机员工
summary: Slower wing delivery and factory stability issues reshape output plans while a long backlog cushions near term impact.
summary_zh: 较慢的机翼交付和工厂稳定性问题重塑了产量计划，而长期的积压则缓冲了近期的影响。
body_en: Journalist – Aaron is an aviation and travel journalist with 14 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry. His background spans airport operations, aviation infrastructure, and travel consulting, having worked with global organizations across New Zealand, Europe, and North America.

Combining industry expertise with firsthand travel experience across more than 52 countries and five continents, Aaron covers airlines, airports, aviation policy, and the wider travel sector. He is based in Canterbury, New Zealand.
His work has been published in Simple Flying and featured by MSN, SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel, EIN News, Pakistan Defence, and Climate Depot.

American plane manufacturer Boeing has announced that it will reduce its workforce by around 5%. Affecting those working in the division of Boeing Commercial Airplanes (BCA), the decision comes as the US plane maker confirmed that it plans to slow down its factory production rate increases as a result of factory and supply chain challenges.
This 5% reduction across the commercial division is forecasted to affect around 2,500 workers, and the headcount reduction will be achieved through involuntary layoffs and natural attrition.
Boeing Lays Out Plans To Cut 5% Of Workforce Due To Supply Chain And Factory Stability.

Boeing, one of the world's largest aircraft manufacturers, will shave around 5% of its workforce beginning in December. The 2,500 positions will see formal layoff notifications starting next month. Chief Executive Officer of Boeing Commercial Airplanes, Stephanie Pope, shared a memo to employees, as shared by CNBC
"Adjusting our production schedules and reducing aircraft output puts us in an overstaffed position. Unfortunately, that means we need to align our staffing levels to our revised business plans."

The decision continues to stem from challenges in the assembly lines and component delivery flows. This has meant that the plane maker must recalibrate to its current supply chain abilities instead of aggressive output targets. This will affect the Boeing 737 MAX and 787 Dreamliner assembly lines .
Simple Flying reached out to Boeing for comment on the layoffs on Monday; however, a company spokesperson could not immediately be reached.

As Boeing looks to stabilize its assembly line and component delivery flows, the Boeing 737 MAX line has had its target timeline of 47 planes per month pushed out until mid to late 2027. This will see fewer planes being delivered but easing the delivery projection bottlenecks that were expected to be seen for wing assembly operations in Renton .

Output increases on the widebody 787 Dreamliner have also been reduced to allow a slower timeline for suppliers to achieve the factory's stability. Despite these changes, Boeing continues to hold a backlog of more than 6,300 airplanes, which is valued in excess of $610 billion.

The ongoing operating losses and supply chain friction continue to weigh on Boeing and its BCA division's short-term recovery. Adjusting the production schedule has ultimately put the plane maker in an overstaffed position, which has led to the decision to lay off 2,500 workers.
Boeing CEO Told Investors The MAX Production Won't Increase Until 2027

Kelly Ortberg , Boeing CEO, spoke to investors last month and outlined that the company will not increase production on the MAX until the second half of 2027, with wing production having been slower than expected. This sees the lifting of the 737 MAX production timeline from 47 to 52 jets per month, pushed out until the second half of 2027.

Ortberg noted in October that while Boeing continues to make progress, there is still 'a lot more work to do', and this is expected to take until the middle of next year. For investors, the overall MAX output has been seen as central to revenue and profit growth after a long period of ongoing financial losses and safety problems (including the deadly MAX crashes in 2018 and 2019 ). The 737 and 787 outputs will remain at 47 and eight jets per month, with ongoing disruption hampering the 767 and 777 programs as well. Targets as detailed below
Low-rate, steady production of a couple per month tied with commercial freighter and KC-46 tanker demand

As noted on the Boeing website, the Boeing Commercial Airplanes division employs a total of 50,494 workers, with the 5% employee cuts resulting in approximately 2,500 jobs. No layoffs are expected in November, with the beginning of job cuts expected in December.

body_zh: 记者 – Aaron 是一名航空和旅行记者，在旅行和旅游业拥有 14 年的经验。他的背景涵盖机场运营、航空基础设施和旅游咨询，曾与新西兰、欧洲和北美的全球组织合作。
Aaron 将行业专业知识与五大洲超过 52 个国家/地区的第一手旅行经验相结合，涵盖航空公司、机场、航空政策和更广泛的旅行领域。他居住在新西兰坎特伯雷。
他的作品发表在《Simple Flying》上，并受到 MSN、SAM CHUI Aviation & Travel、EIN News、Pakistan Defence 和 Climate Depot 的专题报道。
美国飞机制造商波音公司宣布将裁员约5%。这一决定影响了波音商用飞机公司（BCA）部门的工作人员，因为这家美国飞机制造商确认，由于工厂和供应链的挑战，计划放慢工厂生产率的增长。
整个商业部门的 5% 裁员预计将影响约 2,500 名员工，裁员将通过非自愿裁员和自然减员来实现。
由于供应链和工厂稳定，波音公司制定了裁员 5% 的计划。
全球最大的飞机制造商之一波音公司将从 12 月开始裁员约 5%。从下个月开始，这 2,500 个职位将收到正式的裁员通知。 CNBC 分享的波音商用飞机公司首席执行官斯蒂芬妮·波普 (Stephanie Pope) 向员工分享了一份备忘录
“调整我们的生产计划和减少飞机产量使我们陷入人员过剩的境地。不幸的是，这意味着我们需要根据修订后的业务计划调整我们的人员配置水平。”
该决定仍然源于装配线和零部件交付流程中的挑战。这意味着飞机制造商必须重新调整其当前的供应链能力，而不是激进的产量目标。这将影响波音737 MAX和787梦想飞机的装配线。
周一，Simple Flying 联系了波音公司，请其就裁员事宜发表评论；不过，无法立即联系到公司发言人。
由于波音希望稳定其装配线和零部件交付流程，波音 737 MAX 生产线已将每月 47 架飞机的目标时间表推迟到 2027 年中下旬。这将导致交付的飞机数量减少，但缓解伦顿机翼装配业务预计会出现的交付预测瓶颈。
宽体 787 梦想飞机的产量增幅也有所减少，以便供应商能够放慢时间来实现工厂的稳定。尽管发生了这些变化，波音公司仍然积压了 6,300 多架飞机，价值超过 6,100 亿美元。
持续的运营亏损和供应链摩擦继续对波音及其 BCA 部门的短期复苏构成压力。生产计划的调整最终使飞机制造商陷入了人浮于事的境地，从而导致了裁员 2500 名工人的决定。
波音首席执行官告诉投资者 MAX 产量要到 2027 年才会增加
波音公司首席执行官凯利·奥特伯格上个月对投资者表示，公司要到 2027 年下半年才会增加 MAX 的产量，因为机翼生产速度慢于预期。这意味着 737 MAX 的生产时间表从每月 47 架增加到 52 架，推迟到 2027 年下半年。
奥特伯格十月份指出，虽然波音公司继续取得进展，但仍然“还有很多工作要做”，预计要到明年年中。对于投资者来说，在经历了长期持续的财务损失和安全问题（包括 2018 年和 2019 年致命的 MAX 事故）后，MAX 的整体产量被视为收入和利润增长的核心。 737 和 787 的产量将保持在每月 47 架和 8 架，持续的中断也阻碍了 767 和 777 计划。详细目标如下
每月稳定生产几艘，与商业货机和 KC-46 油轮需求相关
正如波音网站所述，波音商用飞机部门共有员工 50,494 名，裁员 5% 导致约 2,500 个工作岗位。预计 11 月份不会裁员，预计 12 月份就会开始裁员。

body_en: Amsterdam Airport Schiphol to hold major security exercise on 19 November - Aviation24.be

Emergency services and airport partners will hold a joint exercise at Amsterdam Schiphol on Thursday, 19 November 2026. The drill will simulate a major security incident involving an aircraft in the airport’s secure airside area.

Participants include Schiphol, KLM, the police and Special Interventions Unit, the Royal Netherlands Marechaussee, fire and ambulance services, the Ministry of Defence and the Kennemerland Safety Region. The exercise will test how the organisations share information and coordinate their response.

Some activity may be visible from public roads. Travellers and residents may see more emergency vehicles than usual, including specialist police vehicles using blue lights and sirens between exercise locations. Organisers say these movements are part of the drill and that they are working to minimise disruption to travellers and airport operations.

body_en: Brussels Airlines launches free Starlink Wi-Fi on first commercial flight - Aviation24.be
Home Lufthansa Group Brussels Airlines Brussels Airlines launches free Starlink Wi-Fi on first commercial flight
Brussels Airlines has launched free high-speed in-flight Wi-Fi powered by Starlink, with the first equipped aircraft operating its inaugural commercial service on Monday, 9 November.

Airbus A320neo OO-SBA operated flight SN2257 from Brussels to Copenhagen, becoming the first Brussels Airlines aircraft to offer the new connectivity service. The airline plans to equip 15 aircraft with Starlink by the first half of 2027, as part of the wider Lufthansa Group rollout.

The service will be free for passengers in all travel classes who have a Travel ID or Miles & More account. It will allow passengers to stream video, work online and use cloud-based applications at high speeds, using Starlink’s low-Earth-orbit satellite network.

To ensure a comfortable environment on board, passengers must use headphones when watching videos or listening to audio. Voice and video calls, as well as live streaming from the aircraft, are not permitted.
The Lufthansa Group plans to equip approximately 850 aircraft across its airlines with Starlink, making it the largest airline group in Europe to introduce the technology across its fleet.

Brussels Airlines says the introduction is part of its broader investment in the passenger experience, alongside improvements to its THE LOFT lounge at Brussels Airport, Premium Economy catering and its Economy Class meal concept.

布鲁塞尔航空公司推出了由 Starlink 提供支持的免费高速机上 Wi-Fi，第一架配备该 Wi-Fi 的飞机将于 11 月 9 日星期一开始其首次商业服务。
空客 A320neo OO-SBA 运营从布鲁塞尔飞往哥本哈根的 SN2257 航班，成为布鲁塞尔航空第一架提供新连接服务的飞机。作为汉莎航空集团更广泛部署的一部分，该航空公司计划到 2027 年上半年为 15 架飞机配备 Starlink。
拥有旅行 ID 或 Miles & More 帐户的所有旅行舱位的乘客均可免费享受该服务。它将允许乘客使用星链的低地球轨道卫星网络传输视频、在线工作并高速使用基于云的应用程序。
为确保机上环境舒适，乘客在观看视频或收听音频时必须使用耳机。不允许进行语音和视频通话以及飞机上的直播。
汉莎航空集团计划为其旗下航空公司的约 850 架飞机配备 Starlink，使其成为欧洲最大的在其机队中引入该技术的航空公司集团。
布鲁塞尔航空公司表示，此次推出是其对乘客体验进行更广泛投资的一部分，同时还改进了布鲁塞尔机场的 THE LOFT 休息室、高级经济舱餐饮和经济舱餐饮概念。

title_en: What The TSA Liquids Rule Really Means At US Checkpoints In 2026
title_zh: 2026 年 TSA 液体规定对美国检查站的真正含义
summary: Even as the TSA changes, the 3-1-1 rule stays the same (for now).
summary_zh: 即使 TSA 发生变化，3-1-1 规则仍然保持不变（目前）。
body_en: Luke Diaz is a freelance military writer with experience with active duty experience in the US Navy as well as defense and industrial engineering. He is a former Naval Flight Officer who performed tactical air control on the carrier-based E-2 Hawkeye.

The Transportation Security Administration (TSA) restriction on liquids, aerosols, and gels, widely known as the 3-1-1 rule in the United States, was not an arbitrary policy. Because legacy X-ray machines could not safely differentiate harmless beverages or toiletries from volatile liquid explosive components, it was implemented by the TSA in August 2006.

The decision followed a counterterrorism operation in the United Kingdom where intelligence thwarted a plot by terrorists to board transatlantic flights and detonate explosives disguised inside soda cans. Since then, advanced Computed Tomography (CT) scanners have improved the screening experience, even as regulations remain the same.

The machine's software can automatically calculate liquid density and identify hazardous substances packed deep inside luggage. CT allows TSA officers to rotate a bag's image a full 360 degrees, dissecting complex internal layers. Today, some airports in the UK and Europe now allow liquids up to two liters. However, the US network has yet to lift the 3-1-1 restriction because advanced scanners have not yet reached nationwide deployment.

The TSA will not lift the 3.4-ounce (100 ml) restriction nationwide until CT scanners are deployed at 100% of airports. To prevent security gaps and avoid confusing travelers moving between upgraded and non-upgraded domestic airports, the TSA is keeping the rule as the national standard. Once every airport in the country is equipped with the same machines, a new liquid policy is expected to follow.

Contrary to speculation among some Americans that it was lifted, the TSA liquids limit remains unchanged today. This misconception stemmed from the introduction of new screening technology, specifically CT scanners. Even with the rollout, travelers are still limited to a single clear, quart-sized plastic bag per person to hold three volume-compliant liquid containers.

Beyond being a mnemonic, the 3-1-1 rule continues to be the guiding principle that dictates the total amount that is allowed. Despite the rule's inconvenience and unpopularity, any modification depends on technological advances that allow reliable fluid identification. The restriction has evolved since its inception.

After the complete ban in 2006, the rule transitioned to the small-bottle and quart-bag limit on September 26, 2006. The change reflected a shift from a three-ounce limit to 3.4 ounces to align with the international standard of 100 milliliters. As of late 2026, over 1,100 million-dollar CT units have been deployed across 300 major domestic airports.

However, the remaining third of the network, comprising hundreds of smaller regional lanes, still depends entirely on legacy 2D X-ray infrastructure. Meanwhile, one public statement from a government official in 2025 triggered rumors about the potential lifting of the rule.
How One Remark From DC Became A National Rumor

On July 8, 2025, the Department of Homeland Security ended the routine passenger shoe-removal requirement, according to CBS News . The sudden, total elimination of this 20-year-old protocol sparked widespread confusion among the flying public. As the signature post-9/11 hassle vanished overnight, it primed passengers to believe that a complete dismantling of all historical checkpoint rules was imminent.

This climate of high expectations set a trap for widespread public confusion just eight days later. On July 16, 2025, then-Secretary Kristi Noem spoke at a conference hosted by The Hill and explicitly singled out the standing policy. By musing that container volume increases would be " the next big announcement ," she inadvertently caused millions of travelers to coordinate internal review with immediate policy changes.

Numerous outlets rapidly repeated her optimistic outlook, envisioning one-minute checkpoint walkthroughs directly to the aircraft gate. However, Noem provided no real details or concrete deployment timelines for a 3-1-1 rule overhaul. Former TSA Administrator John Pistole later confirmed that the agency had quietly evaluated liquid-restriction rollbacks for years.

The general public was led to believe that the technology had been put in place to support Noem's sweeping statement. Yet, more than a year later, the strict 3-1-1 mandate remains unchanged and fully enforceable at every US security checkpoint. Analysts say the core issue driving traveler confusion is that dropping the shoe mandate required no new equipment.

The TSA prioritizes security enhancements over passenger convenience, as Peter Duffy, the agency's federal security director for Alaska, clarified in a July statement, that CT implementation significantly augments threat-detection capabilities. A checkpoint CT scanner operates on the same technological principles as a medical CT unit, using multiple X-ray perspectives of luggage on a conveyor belt to construct a three-dimensional model.

That 3D output lets automated threat-detection algorithms flag potential hazards while agents rotate and inspect the imagery. These scanners have been in deployment for several years. AFAR reported that the TSA began field tests of new scanners at a small number of airports in 2018. Meanwhile, CT units first became operational at Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) in November 2017, according to View from the Wing .

While sources disagree on the first deployment dates, both outline nearly a decade of operational development behind a technology that many passengers encountered for the first time this year. For travelers, the main advantage of CT is keeping laptops and liquids inside their luggage, as AFAR remarked. However, the new CT scanners are limited to luggage that can actually fit through the machine.

A TSA spokesperson was quoted by the Hill, saying the new units cannot accommodate certain large carry-on bags. AFAR noted that while CT scanners are currently being integrated into many PreCheck lanes, flyers with bags that do not fit will be asked to go to secondary screening stations. Screening procedures also remain inconsistent within individual airport terminals.

AFAR advised passengers to follow local rules because many facilities operate a mix of conventional two-dimensional X-ray and advanced CT lanes. In either case, the 3-1-1 restriction still remains fully enforceable, matching the protocol of standard lanes. Consequently, the primary operational variable for air travelers remains the statistical likelihood of encountering a CT-equipped checkpoint during their transit.
body_zh: 卢克·迪亚兹 (Luke Diaz) 是一位自由军事作家，拥有在美国海军以及国防和工业工程领域服役的现役经验。他是一名前海军飞行军官，曾在舰载 E-2 鹰眼上执行战术空中控制。
美国运输安全管理局 (TSA) 对液体、气溶胶和凝胶的限制（在美国被广泛称为 3-1-1 规则）并不是一项任意政策。由于传统 X 光机无法安全地区分无害饮料或盥洗用品与挥发性液体爆炸成分，因此 TSA 于 2006 年 8 月实施了这一措施。
这一决定是在英国的一次反恐行动之后做出的，情报挫败了恐怖分子登上跨大西洋航班并引爆伪装在汽水罐内的爆炸物的阴谋。从那时起，即使法规保持不变，先进的计算机断层扫描 (CT) 扫描仪也改善了筛查体验。
该机器的软件可以自动计算液体密度并识别行李深处的有害物质。 CT 允许 TSA 官员将行李的图像旋转 360 度，剖析复杂的内部层。如今，英国和欧洲的一些机场允许携带最多两升的液体。然而，由于先进的扫描仪尚未在全国范围内部署，美国网络尚未解除3-1-1限制。
在 100% 的机场部署 CT 扫描仪之前，TSA 不会在全国范围内取消 3.4 盎司（100 毫升）的限制。为了防止安全漏洞并避免旅客在升级和未升级的国内机场之间移动时感到困惑，美国运输安全管理局 (TSA) 将该规则保留为国家标准。一旦该国每个机场都配备了相同的机器，预计将出台新的液体政策。
与一些美国人猜测已取消的猜测相反，运输安全管理局的液体限制今天保持不变。这种误解源于新筛查技术的引入，特别是 CT 扫描仪。即使推出后，旅客仍然仅限于每人一个透明的夸脱大小的塑料袋来容纳三个符合容量的液体容器。
除了作为助记符之外，3-1-1 规则仍然是规定允许总量的指导原则。尽管该规则带来不便且不受欢迎，但任何修改都取决于允许可靠流体识别的技术进步。该限制自推出以来一直在演变。
2006 年全面禁止后，该规则于 2006 年 9 月 26 日过渡到小瓶装和夸脱袋装限制。这一变化反映了限制从 3 盎司变为 3.4 盎司，以与 100 毫升的国际标准保持一致。截至2026年底，国内300个主要机场已部署价值超过11亿美元的CT设备。
然而，网络的其余三分之一（包括数百条较小的区域车道）仍然完全依赖于传统的 2D X 射线基础设施。与此同时，一位政府官员在 2025 年发表的一份公开声明引发了有关可能取消该规定的传言。
华盛顿特区的一则言论如何成为全国谣言
据哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道，2025 年 7 月 8 日，国土安全部终止了例行乘客脱鞋的要求。这项已有 20 年历史的协议突然被彻底废除，在飞行公众中引发了广泛的困惑。随着 9/11 事件后标志性的麻烦一夜之间消失，乘客们开始相信所有历史检查站规则即将彻底废除。
仅仅八天后，这种高期望的气氛就给公众带来了广泛的困惑。 2025 年 7 月 16 日，时任国务卿克里斯蒂·诺姆在国会山主办的一次会议上发表讲话，明确指出了长期政策。她认为集装箱吞吐量的增加将是“下一个重大公告”，无意中促使数百万旅客将内部审查与立即的政策变化进行协调。
许多媒体迅速重申了她的乐观前景，设想用一分钟的时间通过检查站直接到达登机口。然而，Noem 没有提供 3-1-1 规则改革的实际细节或具体部署时间表。前运输安全管理局局长约翰·皮斯托尔后来证实，该机构多年来一直在悄悄评估液体限制的回滚。
公众被引导相信这项技术已经到位，以支持诺姆的全面声明。然而，一年多后，严格的 3-1-1 规定仍然没有改变，并且在美国每个安全检查站都可以完全执行。分析人士表示，让旅行者感到困惑的核心问题是，取消穿鞋规定并不需要新的装备。
TSA 将安全增强置于乘客便利之上，正如该机构阿拉斯加联邦安全总监 Peter Duffy 在 7 月份的一份声明中澄清的那样，CT 的实施显着增强了威胁检测能力。检查站 CT 扫描仪的工作原理与医疗 CT 设备相同，利用传送带上行李的多个 X 射线视角来构建三维模型。
该 3D 输出允许自动威胁检测算法在代理旋转和检查图像时标记潜在危险。这些扫描仪已经部署多年。 AFAR 报道称，TSA 于 2018 年开始在少数机场对新型扫描仪进行现场测试。同时，据 View from the Wing 报道，CT 设备于 2017 年 11 月首次在达拉斯/沃斯堡国际机场 (DFW) 投入运行。
尽管消息人士对首次部署日期存在分歧，但两人都概述了许多乘客今年首次遇到的这项技术背后近十年的运营发展。正如 AFAR 所说，对于旅行者来说，CT 的主要优势是将笔记本电脑和液体放在行李中。然而，新的 CT 扫描仪仅限于能够真正穿过机器的行李。
《国会山报》援引运输安全管理局发言人的话说，新单位无法容纳某些大型随身行李。 AFAR 指出，虽然 CT 扫描仪目前已集成到许多预检通道中，但携带不合适行李的传单将被要求前往二次安检站。各个机场航站楼内的安检程序也不一致。
AFAR 建议乘客遵守当地规则，因为许多设施混合使用传统的二维 X 射线和先进的 CT 通道。无论哪种情况，3-1-1 限制仍然完全可执行，与标准通道协议相匹配。因此，航空旅客的主要操作变量仍然是在过境期间遇到配备 CT 的检查站的统计可能性。

At least seven people were killed and 112 injured when two trains collided in Egypt’s Giza governorate, south of Cairo, on Sunday, 8 November 2026, the country’s health ministry said.

Egyptian National Railways said one train struck the rear of another between Kafr Ammar and Al-Raqqa stations, derailing several carriages. Ambulances took the injured to nearby hospitals, while cranes were brought in to clear the wreckage. The health ministry said 45 of those injured had been discharged after their condition improved.
Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ordered an investigation into the collision and offered his condolences to the families of those killed.

body_en: Qatar Airways expands Canadian connections with Porter Airlines codeshare - Aviation24.be

Qatar Airways has signed a codeshare agreement with Porter Airlines for travel from 16 November 2026. The Doha-based carrier will place its QR flight code on selected Porter-operated services connecting through Toronto Pearson and Montréal–Trudeau.

The agreement extends Qatar Airways’ reach beyond its two Canadian gateways to destinations including Edmonton, Halifax, Ottawa, St. John’s and Thunder Bay. Codeshare itineraries can be booked through the Qatar Airways website or app.

Qatar Airways operates daily flights between Doha and each of its Canadian gateways, for a total of 14 weekly services. Travellers from Canada can connect via Doha to destinations including Delhi, Manila, Dubai and Addis Ababa.

卡塔尔航空已与波特航空签署代码共享协议，从 2026 年 11 月 16 日起开始旅行。这家总部位于多哈的航空公司将在波特航空运营的、经多伦多皮尔逊和蒙特利尔 - 特鲁多转机的选定航班上放置其 QR 航班代码。
该协议将卡塔尔航空的业务范围扩展到加拿大的两个门户之外，到达埃德蒙顿、哈利法克斯、渥太华、圣约翰和桑德贝等目的地。代码共享行程可以通过卡塔尔航空网站或应用程序预订。
卡塔尔航空每天运营多哈与其每个加拿大门户之间的航班，每周总共 14 趟航班。来自加拿大的旅客可经多哈转机前往德里、马尼拉、迪拜和亚的斯亚贝巴等目的地。

title_en: Which Airlines Are Dry (No Alcohol)? Can You Bring Your Own Alcohol?
title_zh: 哪些航空公司是无酒精饮料（不含酒精）？您可以自带酒水吗？
summary: Some airlines are dry, but a few let you bring your own alcohol, and others only skip drinks on certain routes. Here's which ones, and whether it matters.
summary_zh: 有些航空公司是无酒精的，但有些航空公司允许您自带酒精饮料，而另一些航空公司则只在某些航线上不提供饮料。这是哪些以及是否无光泽
body_en: For many people, alcohol is an aspect of traveling by air that they enjoy. I’m not just talking about first or business class travel , where a glass of champagne might be part of the fun. Airports are also one of the few places where you can have a drink at 5AM and not be judged (too hard).
Admittedly customs differ around the globe, based on culture, religion, etc. In this post, I thought it would be interesting to talk a bit about dry airlines, as there’s a bit of nuance to this.
Which airlines don’t serve alcohol onboard? Which airlines don’t serve alcohol but let you bring your own alcohol? And does all of this even matter?
Let’s start by taking a look at the airlines that are dry, meaning that they don’t serve you alcohol. Here are the airlines that come to mind

Admittedly that list isn’t totally exhaustive, since there are a countless number of small airlines out there. However, I think this covers the biggest and most interesting airlines that don’t serve alcohol (though if I missed any major ones, please let me know).
Which dry airlines will let you bring your own alcohol?

There’s an interesting twist to this. While some airlines are dry, they’ll let you bring your own alcohol onboard, and then you can consume it (within reason). The following three international carriers come to mind
Now, it’s important to note that this isn’t without strings attached
It’s at the crew’s discretion whether you can consume alcohol or not; if you plan to consume alcohol, definitely ask the crew for permission first, or else there could be consequences

Often there are restrictions around the situations in which you can bring alcohol; for example, on Royal Brunei you can only consume alcohol on flights to Brunei, since alcohol is banned in the country (so it would need to be dumped before landing), while on EgyptAir you could even buy it in duty free in Cairo, and then consume it onboard

When I flew Kuwait Airways several years back, I wrote about how we brought a bottle of wine onboard, and they gladly let us consume it . It’s not that I couldn’t be without alcohol, but I was curious to experience a BYOB concept on a plane, since that was novel for me.

There’s an added layer of complexity to all of this, as there are some airlines that aren’t generally dry, but are dry on certain routes. Several situations come to mind (let me know if I’m missing any)

Airlines flying to & from Saudi Arabia can’t serve alcohol in Saudi Arabian airspace; while they could technically serve drinks outside of that airspace, most airlines just ban alcohol on Saudi Arabia routes altogether, to keep things simple

There are several airlines that don’t serve alcohol on domestic flights, including Air India, Oman Air, Thai Airways, and Turkish Airlines (in some cases it’s due to local laws, rather than airline policies — for example, in India, it’s not legal to serve alcohol on domestic flights)
Some airlines, like Aerolineas Argentinas, don’t serve alcohol on regional flights, but do serve alcohol on longer, international routes
On regional flights, Malaysia Airlines is unique for not putting alcohol on the menu or displaying it on the cart during service, but still having wine available upon request
Unrelated to whether airlines are dry or not, keep in mind that some airlines don’t serve alcohol on the ground , since alcohol is often taxed in such situations
As you can tell, in some of the above situations, the lack of alcohol presumably has little to do with religion or concerns over behavior, and more to do with controlling costs.

People have different takes as to how “bad” it is to fly on a dry airline. On the one end of the spectrum, there are people who will avoid dry airlines at all costs. On the other end of the spectrum, you have billions of people who don’t drink alcohol at all, so this is a non-issue.
Personally I’m probably somewhere in the middle
body_zh: 对于许多人来说，酒精是他们喜欢乘坐飞机旅行的一个方面。我所说的不仅仅是头等舱或商务舱旅行，一杯香槟可能也是其中的乐趣之一。机场也是少数几个可以在凌晨 5 点喝一杯而不被评判的地方之一（太难了）。
诚然，由于文化、宗教等原因，全球各地的习俗有所不同。在这篇文章中，我认为谈论一下干航空公司会很有趣，因为这其中有一些细微差别。
哪些航空公司不提供机上酒精饮料？哪些航空公司不提供酒精饮料，但允许您自带酒精饮料？这一切还重要吗？
让我们首先看一下那些不提供酒精饮料的航空公司。以下是我想到的航空公司
诚然，该列表并不完全详尽，因为有无数的小型航空公司。不过，我认为这涵盖了最大、最有趣的不提供酒精饮料的航空公司（如果我错过了任何主要航空公司，请告诉我）。
哪些干航空公司允许您自带酒水？
这有一个有趣的转折。虽然有些航空公司是干的，但他们会让你自带酒类登机，然后你就可以饮用（在合理范围内）。我想到了以下三个国际航空公司
现在，重要的是要注意这并非没有附加条件
您是否可以饮酒由机组人员自行决定；如果您打算喝酒，一定要先征得机组人员的许可，否则可能会产生后果
通常，您可以携带酒精的情况有限制；例如，在文莱皇家航空上，您只能在飞往文莱的航班上饮酒，因为该国禁止饮酒（因此需要在着陆前倾倒），而在埃及航空上，您甚至可以在开罗免税店购买，然后在机上饮用
几年前，当我乘坐科威特航空公司的航班时，我写过我们如何带一瓶酒登机，他们很高兴地让我们饮用。并不是说我不能没有酒精，但我很好奇在飞机上体验自带酒水的概念，因为这对我来说很新奇。
所有这一切都增加了一层复杂性，因为有些航空公司总体上并不干燥，但在某些航线上却很干燥。我想到了几种情况（如果我遗漏了，请告诉我）
往返沙特阿拉伯的航空公司不能在沙特阿拉伯领空提供酒精饮料；虽然从技术上讲，他们可以在该空域之外提供饮料，但为了简单起见，大多数航空公司只是在沙特阿拉伯航线上完全禁止饮酒
有几家航空公司不在国内航班上提供酒精饮料，包括印度航空、阿曼航空、泰国航空和土耳其航空（在某些情况下，这是由于当地法律，而不是航空公司政策 - 例如，在印度，在国内航班上提供酒精饮料是不合法的）
一些航空公司（例如阿根廷航空公司）在支线航班上不提供酒精饮料，但在长途国际航线上提供酒精饮料
在支线航班上，马来西亚航空的独特之处在于，它不会在菜单上添加酒精饮料，也不会在服务期间将其显示在购物车上，但仍可根据要求提供葡萄酒
与航空公司是否干燥无关，请记住，有些航空公司不在地面上提供酒精饮料，因为在这种情况下通常会对酒精征税
正如您所知，在上述某些情况下，缺乏酒精可能与宗教或对行为的担忧关系不大，而更多地与控制成本有关。
对于乘坐无水航班有多“糟糕”，人们有不同的看法。一方面，有些人会不惜一切代价避开干航空公司。另一方面，有数十亿人根本不喝酒，所以这不是问题。
就我个人而言，我可能处于中间位置

Home Airbus Airbus - Defence and Space France awards Airbus-led consortium €1.5bn-plus IRIS satellite contract

France’s defence procurement agency, the DGA, has awarded Airbus Defence and Space and Thales Alenia Space a contract worth more than €1.5 billion to develop two IRIS military Earth observation satellites. The contract runs until the end of the 2030s and covers design, manufacture and testing, as well as ground systems, in-orbit operations and maintenance.

IRIS will replace France’s CSO satellites. It is designed to deliver sharper images more quickly, with day-and-night coverage in visible and infrared wavelengths. The satellites will also be able to image objects in orbit to support space surveillance.

Airbus, the lead contractor, will supply both satellite platforms, provide a substantial part of the first satellite’s imaging payload and oversee the ground systems. Thales Alenia Space will develop the second satellite’s payload, supply key components for the first and contribute to the ground systems. Airbus said the programme remains open to cooperation with allied nations.

airBaltic has signed a new longer-term wet lease agreement with Lufthansa Group, extending an existing partnership. The Latvian carrier will operate up to six Airbus A220-300s with its own crews for the group during the summer season and up to four in winter.

The deal forms part of airBaltic’s business plan for 2027, when it expects to operate a fleet of 36 aircraft. The airline will continue to allocate aircraft to wet lease contracts alongside its own scheduled services.
airBaltic will also continue its wet lease partnership with Air Serbia, with four A220-300s planned for summer and two for winter.

title_en: The Striking Differences Between JetBlue Mint & Delta One Transcontinental In 2026
title_zh: 2026 年捷蓝薄荷航空与达美一号横贯大陆航空之间的显着差异
summary: JetBlue offers more inflight value but Delta's ground experience is hard to beat.
summary_zh: 捷蓝航空提供更多的机上价值，但达美航空的地面体验无可比拟。
body_en: Jack comes to Simple Flying with a lifelong interest in all things aviation. He holds a degree in Aerospace Engineering from Georgia Tech, and is a certified private and remote pilot. Beyond these experiences, Jack previously worked for a corporate flight department where he gained first-hand experience in the world of business aviation. Currently, Jack works in the professional services industry and continues to build his flight hours outside of work.

JetBlue Airways and Delta Air Lines both promise a lie-flat seat on the roughly six-hour journey between New York and Los Angeles, but the similarities become less convincing once passengers look beyond the cabin label. JetBlue built Mint around a consistent, suite-focused transcontinental product, while Delta’s Delta One experience depends more heavily on the aircraft assigned to a flight. The difference affects privacy, seat dimensions, dining, and the likelihood of receiving the newest version of the product.

The ground experience widens the gap in another direction. Delta has dedicated Delta One Lounges at both John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) and Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), with restaurant-style dining and wellness facilities. JetBlue’s BlueHouse lounges provide a newer, more approachable alternative, but they are smaller and have different access rules. Mint can be less expensive than Delta One, although fares fluctuate substantially by date, demand, and departure time. In 2026, choosing between them is less about identifying one universal winner and more about deciding whether a consistent onboard suite or a stronger premium airport experience matters most.
Mint Offers More Consistent Privacy Across Its Aircraft

JetBlue introduced Mint on June 15, 2014, with its first service between JFK and LAX. At launch, four of its 16 business-class seats were private suites, an unusual feature on a domestic route. On the Airbus A321neo and Airbus A321LR aircraft equipped with Mint, every seat is a private suite with direct aisle access. The front-row Mint Studios add a guest seat, table, storage, and a 22-inch (55 cm) screen. The A321neo has 16 Mint places, including two Studios, while the A321LR has a larger Mint cabin.

Older A321 Classic aircraft retain a mixed cabin, with four private suites and 12 open seats arranged in pairs. Those seats still convert into beds, but lack the privacy of the newer suites. Passengers should check the aircraft and seat map before booking. Delta One has a more pronounced aircraft divide. Its true suites with full-height sliding doors are found on the Airbus A350 and Airbus A330-900neo. However, the JFK-LAX route is commonly operated by Boeing 767-400ER aircraft, whose Delta One seats recline into flat beds but do not have doors. A Delta One booking, therefore, does not guarantee an enclosed suite, and an aircraft substitution can change the experience.

The Boeing 767-400ER is a capable transcontinental aircraft, but its Delta One cabin reflects an older generation of premium seating. Delta lists 34 business class seats on the type, each measuring 20 inches (50.8 centimeters) wide and converting into a 77-inch (195.6 centimeters) lie-flat bed. The cabin is less private than the enclosed suites on Delta’s newer Airbus widebodies.

One Mile at a Time's review of Delta’s JFK-LAX 767-400ER describes the seat as comfortable enough for a coast-to-coast flight, but notes that the cabin feels dated and comparatively tight. The lack of a privacy door is not the only difference: the seat is narrower and the sleeping surface shorter than on Delta’s A330-900neo. The compromises matter more to travelers hoping to sleep than to those flying during the day.

Mint’s newer A321neo and A321LR suites are designed specifically around the single-passenger space. JetBlue advertises fully lie-flat beds, Tuft & Needle foam cushioning, large touchscreen entertainment, dedicated storage, and wireless charging on the newer aircraft. Mint also includes free high-speed WiFi, while its front-row Studios add room to work or share the space with a companion. That consistency gives JetBlue an advantage for passengers who value privacy more than cabin size. The A321 remains a narrowbody, while Delta’s 767 provides a wider aircraft environment without necessarily offering a more advanced seat. The most meaningful comparison is therefore between the exact aircraft and seat, not the airlines’ premium brand names.
Dining And Entertainment Options Give Each A Distinctive Identity

JetBlue has used food and entertainment to differentiate Mint since its introduction. The airline’s original transcontinental service featured small-plate dining, while its current menu has partnerships with New York restaurants Crown Shy and Birdee. The menus began appearing on select domestic and transatlantic flights on July 31, 2026. Mint passengers can also order cocktails prepared onboard, with a wine list curated in partnership with New York retailer Parcelle. The dining format gives passengers more control over when and how they eat. JetBlue also offers an express evening meal service, called Savor & Sleep, on US coast-to-coast departures after 8:00 PM. That option is useful for travelers who would rather settle into bed than spend a large part of the flight waiting for a traditional meal service. Availability depends on the flight and menu rotation.

Delta One takes a more traditional premium dining approach, with chef-curated meals, premium wines, and a service sequence built around the longer-haul business-class experience. Delta adds Missoni bedding and amenity kits, hot towels, entertainment, and free Delta Sync WiFi for SkyMiles members. Delta also offers meal pre-orders until 18 hours before departure , the shortest window of the big three legacy carriers in the US.

JetBlue’s small plates feel contemporary, while Delta offers a more traditional premium dining and bedding package. Travelers who prioritize sleep may find the timing of meal service more relevant than the menu itself. Those who prefer a full meal and a broad wine selection may lean toward Delta, although the specific flight and catering can influence the result.
Delta Has The Stronger Dedicated Lounge Experience

Delta’s clearest advantage appears before departure. The airline operates Delta One Lounges at JFK and LAX, allowing eligible passengers to use dedicated premium facilities rather than relying on a standard Sky Club. The JFK location features a brasserie with table service, a market and bakery, an outdoor terrace, shower suites, and wellness facilities. LAX also has dining , nap pods, and massage chairs.
body_zh: Jack 带着对航空一切事物的终生兴趣加入了 Simple Flying。他拥有佐治亚理工学院的航空航天工程学位，并且是一名经过认证的私人和远程飞行员。除了这些经验之外，杰克还曾在公司飞行部门工作过，在那里他获得了公务航空领域的第一手经验。目前，杰克在专业服务行业工作，并在工作之外继续增加飞行时间。
捷蓝航空和达美航空都承诺在纽约和洛杉矶之间大约六小时的旅程中提供平躺式座椅，但一旦乘客超越机舱标签，它们的相似之处就变得不那么令人信服了。捷蓝航空围绕一致的、以套房为中心的跨大陆产品打造了 Mint，而达美航空的达美一号体验则更多地取决于分配给航班的飞机。这种差异会影响隐私、座椅尺寸、餐饮以及收到最新版本产品的可能性。

地面经验在另一个方向上扩大了差距。达美航空在约翰·肯尼迪国际机场 (JFK) 和洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX) 均设有专用的达美一号贵宾室，提供餐厅式餐饮和健康设施。捷蓝航空的 BlueHouse 休息室提供了一种更新、更平易近人的选择，但它们较小，并且有不同的访问规则。尽管票价会根据日期、需求和出发时间而大幅波动，但 Mint 可能比达美一号便宜。到 2026 年，在它们之间进行选择不再是为了确定一个普遍的赢家，而是为了决定是一致的机上套房还是更强大的优质机场体验最重要。
Mint 在其飞机上提供更一致的隐私

捷蓝航空于 2014 年 6 月 15 日推出 Mint，这是肯尼迪机场和洛杉矶国际机场之间的首条航班。刚推出时，其 16 个商务舱座位中有 4 个是私人套间，这在国内航线上是一个不寻常的特点。在配备 Mint 的空客 A321neo 和空客 A321LR 飞机上，每个座位都是可直接通往过道的私人套房。前排 Mint Studio 增设了宾客座椅、桌子、储物空间和 22 英寸（55 厘米）屏幕。 A321neo 有 16 个 Mint 场所，其中包括两个工作室，而 A321LR 则拥有更大的 Mint 机舱。

较旧的 A321 Classic 飞机保留了混合客舱，设有 4 个私人套间和 12 个成对排列的开放式座椅。这些座位仍然可以转换成床，但缺乏新套房的隐私性。旅客应在预订前查看飞机和座位图。达美一号的飞机差距更为明显。空客 A350 和空客 A330-900neo 上都配备了真正的全高滑动门套房。然而，肯尼迪-洛杉矶国际机场航线通常由波音 767-400ER 飞机运营，其达美一号飞机的座椅可以平躺，但没有门。因此，达美一号的预订并不能保证提供封闭式套房，更换飞机可能会改变体验。
波音 767-400ER 是一款功能强大的横贯大陆飞机，但其达美一号客舱采用的是老一代的高级座椅。达美航空列出了该机型的 34 个商务舱座位，每个座位宽 20 英寸（50.8 厘米），可转换成 77 英寸（195.6 厘米）的平躺床。机舱的私密性不如达美新型空客宽体飞机上的封闭式套房。
《一次一英里》对达美航空 JFK-LAX 767-400ER 的评论称，该座椅对于海岸到海岸的航班来说足够舒适，但指出​​机舱感觉过时且相对紧凑。缺少隐私门并不是唯一的区别：与达美航空的 A330-900neo 相比，座椅更窄，睡眠区更短。对于希望睡觉的旅客来说，这些妥协比白天飞行的旅客更重要。

Mint 较新的 A321neo 和 A321LR 套房专为单乘客空间而设计。捷蓝航空在新款飞机上宣传完全平躺的床、Tuft & Needle 泡沫缓冲垫、大型触摸屏娱乐系统、专用存储空间和无线充电功能。 Mint 还提供免费高速 WiFi，而其前排单间公寓则增加了工作或与同伴共享空间的空间。这种一致性为捷蓝航空为那些重视隐私而不是机舱大小的乘客提供了优势。 A321 仍然是窄体飞机，而达美航空的 767 提供了更广阔的飞机环境，但不一定提供更先进的座椅。因此，最有意义的比较是在确切的飞机和座位之间，而不是航空公司的优质品牌名称之间。
餐饮和娱乐选择赋予每个人独特的身份

自成立以来，捷蓝航空就利用美食和娱乐来使 Mint 脱颖而出。该航空公司最初的跨大陆服务以小盘餐饮为特色，而目前的菜单与纽约餐厅 Crown Shy 和 Birdee 建立了合作关系。这些菜单于 2026 年 7 月 31 日开始出现在部分国内和跨大西洋航班上。Mint 乘客还可以订购机上准备的鸡尾酒，以及与纽约零售商 Parcelle 合作策划的酒单。这种用餐方式让乘客可以更好地控制用餐时间和方式。捷蓝航空还为晚上 8:00 之后从美国东海岸出发的航班提供名为 Savor & Sleep 的快捷晚餐服务。对于那些宁愿躺在床上也不愿花大部分飞行时间等待传统餐饮服务的旅客来说，这个选项非常有用。可用性取决于航班和菜单轮换。
达美一号采用更传统的高级餐饮方式，提供厨师精心烹制的餐点、优质葡萄酒以及围绕长途商务舱体验打造的服务序列。达美航空为“飞凡里程常客计划”会员增加了米索尼 (Missoni) 床上用品和洗漱用品包、热毛巾、娱乐设施以及免费达美同步 WiFi。达美航空还在出发前 18 小时提供餐食预订，这是美国三大传统航空公司中最短的窗口。
捷蓝航空的小餐盘给人现代感，而达美航空则提供更传统的优质餐饮和床上用品套餐。优先考虑睡眠的旅行者可能会发现餐饮服务的时间比菜单本身更重要。那些喜欢正餐和多种葡萄酒选择的人可能会倾向于达美航空，尽管特定的航班和餐饮可能会影响结果。
达美航空拥有更强大的专用休息室体验
达美航空最明显的优势在出发前就显现出来了。该航空公司在肯尼迪机场和洛杉矶国际机场运营达美一号休息室，允许符合条件的乘客使用专用的高级设施，而不是依赖标准的天空俱乐部。肯尼迪机场设有提供餐桌服务的小酒馆、市场和面包店、室外露台、淋浴间和健康设施。洛杉矶国际机场还设有餐厅、午睡室和按摩椅。

body_en: James lives and breathes route development. Educated in Air Transport Management at Loughborough University and Cranfield University, James has a PhD in Airline Strategy and Economics. James was Market Opportunity Analyst at London Luton Airport and Chief Analyst at anna.aero. He taught airline strategy and economics to undergraduate and postgraduate students for five years and has worked closely with multiple carriers on route and market intelligence projects. He is based near London, UK.

Alaska Airlines' second-busiest hub is Portland International Airport (PDX). It ranks second in multiple ways: passengers, flights, seats for sale, and so on. In the latest schedule update, the oneworld member has removed flights to Baltimore, Jackson Hole, and St. Louis , while service to New Orleans was already confirmed as not returning .

Each week, airlines from around the world submit schedule changes to platforms like OAG and Cirium Diio. The changes cover everything, including new routes, markets that have been removed, equipment swaps, different timings, higher or lower capacity on existing links, different operating periods, and more.
Alaska Airlines Cuts These Routes From Portland

The latest update indicates that all flights on the following routes have been removed. They all had very time-limited service with Alaska Airlines, with the quartet of links launching or returning in 2025 or 2026. They materialized, or resumed, amid Alaska Airlines' PDX redevelopment.
Destination Still In Alaska Airlines' Network?
Daily seasonal service from May 13 until September 29 on the 737-900ER
Twice-weekly seasonal service from June 12 until September 29 on SkyWest E175
Yes, with flights from San Diego, San Francisco, and Seattle

The changes mean that PDX will no longer have any nonstop service to New Orleans or Jackson Hole . But it is not all bad news for travelers, as Southwest Airlines will continue to fly from Oregon's primary airport to Baltimore and St. Louis, which are among the hybrid operator's most-served cities. However, just because another airline will operate does not tell the full story.

Alaska Airlines planned a daily operation to both Baltimore and St. Louis. While Southwest has a daily seasonal service to Maryland, only a twice-weekly summer operation is scheduled for Missouri. In July 2027, for example, the changes mean that 79% of flights to St. Louis have been removed, while half of those to Baltimore have been pulled.

Given they have all been removed, the answer might be obvious. Moving past that, it is worth examining US Department of Transportation (DOT) data. However, as it is currently only available through July 2026, it is not a complete picture.

From January 2025 until May 2026, Alaska Airlines carried 27,481 passengers to/from Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport (MSY) with a very low load factor of 67.6%. The same source indicates that 70.1% of the traffic was local; they only flew between PDX and MSY. What is more notable is that PDX's distance-adjusted total revenue per available seat mile was 25% lower than for Seattle-MSY.

body_zh: 詹姆斯与路线开发息息相关。詹姆斯曾就读于拉夫堡大学和克兰菲尔德大学航空运输管理专业，拥有航空公司战略和经济学博士学位。 James 曾任伦敦卢顿机场市场机会分析师和 anna.aero 首席分析师。他向本科生和研究生教授航空公司战略和经济学五年，并与多家航空公司在航线和市场情报项目上密切合作。他居住在英国伦敦附近。
阿拉斯加航空第二繁忙的枢纽是波特兰国际机场 (PDX)。它在乘客、航班、待售座位等多个方面均排名第二。在最新的时刻表更新中，寰宇一家成员已取消飞往巴尔的摩、杰克逊霍尔和圣路易斯的航班，而飞往新奥尔良的航班已被确认不会返回。
每周，世界各地的航空公司都会向 OAG 和 Cirium Diio 等平台提交航班时刻表变更信息。这些变化涵盖了一切，包括新航线、已移除的市场、设备交换、不同的时间安排、现有线路的更高或更低的容量、不同的运营时间等等。
阿拉斯加航空削减了从波特兰出发的这些航线
最新更新显示，以下航线的所有航班均已取消。它们都与阿拉斯加航空签订了非常有时间限制的服务，四条航线将于 2025 年或 2026 年开通或返回。它们在阿拉斯加航空的 PDX 重建过程中实现或恢复。
目的地仍在阿拉斯加航空的网络中吗？
5 月 13 日至 9 月 29 日期间，737-900ER 提供每日季节性服务
6 月 12 日至 9 月 29 日期间，SkyWest E175 每周提供两次季节性服务
是的，有从圣地亚哥、旧金山和西雅图出发的航班
这些变化意味着 PDX 将不再提供飞往新奥尔良或杰克逊霍尔的任何直达航班。但这对旅客来说并不全是坏消息，因为西南航空将继续从俄勒冈州的主要机场飞往巴尔的摩和圣路易斯，这家混合运营商服务最频繁的城市之一。然而，仅仅因为另一家航空公司将运营并不能说明全部情况。
阿拉斯加航空公司计划每日运营飞往巴尔的摩和圣路易斯的航班。虽然西南航空每天都有飞往马里兰州的季节性航班，但夏季仅安排每周两次飞往密苏里州的航班。例如，2027 年 7 月，这些变化意味着 79% 飞往圣路易斯的航班被取消，而飞往巴尔的摩的航班则被取消一半。
鉴于它们已全部被删除，答案可能是显而易见的。除此之外，值得研究一下美国交通部 (DOT) 的数据。然而，由于它目前仅在 2026 年 7 月之前可用，因此它并不是完整的图片。
2025 年 1 月至 2026 年 5 月，阿拉斯加航空运送了 27,481 名乘客往返于路易斯·阿姆斯特朗新奥尔良国际机场 (MSY)，客座率极低，仅为 67.6%。同一来源表明，70.1% 的流量来自本地；他们只在 PDX 和 MSY 之间飞行。更值得注意的是，PDX 按距离调整后的每可用座位英里总收入比西雅图-MSY 低 25%。

body_en: Air Arabia Maroc A320 came within 41 feet of the sea after take-off - Aviation24.be
Home Air Arabia Air Arabia Maroc Air Arabia Maroc A320 came within 41 feet of the sea after...

An Air Arabia Maroc Airbus A320 came dangerously close to crashing into the sea shortly after take-off from Catania Airport, Italy, on 20 September 2025. The final investigation report by Italy’s National Flight Safety Agency (ANSV) reveals a series of cockpit errors that brought the aircraft to just 41 feet (12.5 metres) above the water.

The aircraft, registration CN-NML, was operating flight MAC991 to Amman without passengers, carrying two pilots and four cabin crew members. Investigators found that essential take-off speeds had not been correctly entered into the flight management system. Despite noticing missing flight indications during the take-off roll, the captain continued the departure.

After lifting off, the aircraft climbed to approximately 383 feet before entering a steep descent. The ground proximity warning system issued “SINK RATE” and “PULL UP” alerts. At only 162 feet, the captain applied maximum thrust and pulled back on the controls, allowing the aircraft to recover and continue to Amman.

Investigators considered whether the captain may have experienced a somatogravic illusion, in which acceleration and darkness can distort a pilot’s perception of the aircraft’s attitude. However, this could not be conclusively established. The investigation also highlighted concerns about cockpit monitoring and the first officer’s ability to intervene, although the cockpit voice recording was no longer available.

The report found no evidence of an aircraft malfunction. It also noted that the A320’s older flight management software did not provide an additional warning about missing take-off speeds. ANSV recommended that EASA consider measures to introduce the improved software standard across the A320 family.
Air Arabia Maroc subsequently terminated the contracts of both pilots and introduced additional training and software upgrades.
Sources: Italian National Flight Safety Agency (ANSV), final investigation report CN-NML; Hespress; Sky TG24; AeroCorner.

2025 年 9 月 20 日，阿拉伯摩洛哥航空的一架空客 A320 从意大利卡塔尼亚机场起飞后不久，险些坠入大海。意大利国家飞行安全局 (ANSV) 的最终调查报告揭示了一系列驾驶舱错误，导致飞机仅距水面 41 英尺（12.5 米）。
这架注册为 CN-NML 的飞机执飞飞往安曼的 MAC991 航班，机上没有乘客，机上有两名飞行员和四名机组人员。调查人员发现，必要的起飞速度尚未正确输入飞行管理系统。尽管在起飞滑跑期间发现航班指示缺失，机长仍继续起飞。
起飞后，飞机爬升至约 383 英尺，然后进入陡峭下降。近地警告系统发出“SINK RATE”和“PULL UP”警报。在仅 162 英尺处，机长施加最大推力并拉回控制装置，使飞机恢复并继续飞往安曼。
调查人员考虑机长是否可能经历了体重力错觉，其中加速和黑暗会扭曲飞行员对飞机姿态的感知。然而，这并不能最终确定。调查还强调了对驾驶舱监控和副驾驶干预能力的担忧，尽管驾驶舱录音已不再可用。
报告没有发现飞机故障的证据。它还指出，A320 较旧的飞行管理软件没有提供有关起飞速度缺失的额外警告。 ANSV 建议 EASA 考虑采取措施，在 A320 系列中引入改进的软件标准。
阿拉伯摩洛哥航空公司随后终止了两名飞行员的合同，并引入了额外的培训和软件升级。

body_en: Air France A350 causes loss of separation with American Airlines A321 after unexpected turn at LAX - Aviation24.be
Home Air France KLM Group Air France Air France A350 causes loss of separation with American Airlines A321 after...

An Air France Airbus A350-900 and an American Airlines Airbus A321 were involved in a loss of separation shortly after departing Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) on 7 November. Air traffic controllers intervened urgently after the two aircraft came into close proximity during their initial climb.

Air France flight AF028, operated by Airbus A350-900 registered F-HUVK, departed runway 24L at approximately 00:15 local time, bound for Papeete, French Polynesia. About one minute later, American Airlines flight AA1660, an Airbus A321-200 registered N191UW, departed parallel runway 25R for Dallas/Fort Worth.

According to recorded air traffic control communications, the Air France aircraft unexpectedly turned left towards the departure path of the American Airlines aircraft. The controller immediately instructed the Air France crew to fly heading 270, while American Airlines was warned of traffic at its 12 o’clock position, less than one mile away, and instructed to maintain 2,000 feet.

Flight-tracking data published by Wingbits suggested that the aircraft came within approximately 300 feet (91 metres) vertically of each other, although other reports estimated around 400 feet (122 metres). The precise closest separation has not been officially established.

Following the incident, the controller questioned the Air France crew about the unexpected manoeuvre. The pilots confirmed they had been instructed to follow the SUMMR2 departure procedure. The controller subsequently referred to a possible pilot deviation and provided the crew with a telephone number to call.

Both aircraft continued their flights safely. Air France subsequently confirmed that its crew had received instructions from air traffic control to adjust their trajectory and had immediately complied.

首页 法航 荷航集团 法航 法航 A350 与美国航空 A321 发生分离事故...
11 月 7 日，法国航空的一架空客 A350-900 飞机和美国航空的一架空客 A321 飞机在离开洛杉矶国际机场 (LAX) 后不久发生分离事故。两架飞机在最初爬升过程中非常接近，空中交通管制员紧急干预。
法国航空 AF028 航班由注册号为 F-HUVK 的空客 A350-900 运营，于当地时间 00:15 左右从 24L 跑道起飞，飞往法属波利尼西亚帕皮提。大约一分钟后，美国航空 AA1660 航班（注册号为 N191UW 的空客 A321-200）从平行跑道 25R 起飞，飞往达拉斯/沃斯堡。
根据空中交通管制通讯记录，法航飞机意外左转，驶向美国航空飞机的出发航线。管制员立即指示法航机组人员以 270 号航向飞行，而美国航空则在 12 点钟位置（距离不到一英里）收到交通警告，并指示保持 2,000 英尺的高度。
Wingbits 发布的飞行跟踪数据表明，两架飞机的垂直距离在大约 300 英尺（91 米）范围内，但其他报告估计约为 400 英尺（122 米）。精确的最近距离尚未正式确定。
事件发生后，管制员向法航机组人员询问了这一意外的举动。飞行员确认他们已被指示遵循 SUMMR2 离场程序。管制员随后指出飞行员可能出现偏差，并向机组人员提供了可以拨打的电话号码。
两架飞机继续安全飞行。法航随后证实，其机组人员已收到空中交通管制部门调整航线的指示，并立即遵照执行。
